```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(countrycode)
library(readxl)

# Gender Inequality Index
gii <- read_csv(
  "../Data/week4/gii.csv"
)

# World spatial data
world <- st_read(
  "../Data/week4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_-7542350475356456390/World_Countries_Generalized.shp"
)
```

```{r}
names(gii)
names(world)

glimpse(gii)
glimpse(world)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)

gii_raw <- read_csv(
  "../Data/week4/gii.csv",
  col_names = FALSE
)

print(gii_raw[1:15, 1:8])

library(dplyr)

gii |>
  filter(indexCode == "GII") |>
  distinct(indicatorCode, indicator) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

gii_change <- gii |>
  filter(
    indicatorCode == "gii",
    year %in% c(2010, 2019)
  ) |>
  select(
    iso3 = countryIsoCode,
    country,
    year,
    value
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "GII_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gii_diff = GII_2019 - GII_2010
  )

head(gii_change)
```

```{r}
world_gii <- world |>
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(ISO, "iso2c", "iso3c")
  ) |>
  left_join(gii_change, by = "iso3")


```


```{r}
# 查看结果
head(st_drop_geometry(world_gii))

# 成功匹配的空间要素数量
sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))

# 没有完整 GII 差值的空间要素数量
sum(is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))

world_gii |>
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(COUNTRY, ISO, iso3)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(world_gii) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = gii_diff),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Change in Gender Inequality",
    subtitle = "2010–2019",
    fill = "Δ GII",
    caption = "Source: UNDP Human Development Reports"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
